broader representativeness is unresolved."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Developer review and corrections document checking, but comprehensive checks of reference outputs are not established."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The puzzles exercise grid-rule inference, but coverage of broader reasoning is not demonstrated."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact matching rewards correct outputs, but scores alone do not establish how the rule was inferred."},{"id":11,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The averaging procedure is explicit, but evidence supporting its interpretation as an ability measure is limited."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public marking tests cover correct outputs, wrong sizes, changed squares and missing outputs; full-system validation remains limited."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Human difficulty results and AI scores provide context, but the human study covered a larger puzzle pool than the final test."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Verified testing uses one run; no repeated-run study is supplied."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No systematic study of changes to instructions, presentation or software is supplied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The reviewed materials provide no estimates or ranges for repeated-run score variation."},{"id":17,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Developers investigated repeated rules and designed puzzles to resist large program searches; these checks are not exhaustive."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Hidden-data agreements and exposure monitoring address risk, while public tasks remain accessible and leakage remains possible."},{"id":19,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Development training is allowed, evaluation-specific tuning is discouraged and verified feedback is restricted to preserve evaluation separation."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No study links scores to language, social interaction or real-world work."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified settings and human difficulty matching help, but other testing routes differ and AI equivalence across sets is unestablished."},{"id":22,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public problems, running software and marking tests support inspection and repetition of the public evaluation."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public licensing and hidden-data confidentiality, handling and review rules are stated."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Dated problem and code changes are recorded, but affected AI scores are not comprehensively recalculated."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid-task comparisons are supported; connections to broader intelligence exceed the supplied validation."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire distinguishes documented procedures from evidence supporting score interpretations. Exact-match scoring supports claims about output correctness, while broader reasoning claims need additional evidence. Items about whether testing occurred should remain separate from whether that testing was comprehensive or favourable.","supported_claims":["Scores summarize exact output-grid success with two permitted attempts and averaging within problems.","Human solving results informed puzzle selection and difficulty matching.","Public marking tests check several specified scoring cases."],"documented_problems":["Software permits fractional problem scores, while the dataset description reserves fully solved for entirely correct problems.","Public revisions correct coloured squares and unclear examples.","Verified evaluations use one run, and revisions do not trigger comprehensive score recalculation."],"missing_information":["Repeated-run variability and sensitivity to changed testing conditions.","Evidence connecting grid scores to broader abilities or real-world outcomes.","Evidence that human difficulty matching makes the sets equivalent for AI comparisons."],"reinterpretations":["Interpret reported scores as average input-grid success within problems, rather than necessarily the percentage of fully solved problems.","Treat similar human difficulty as a selection property, not evidence of stable AI scores.","Treat broader intelligence relationships as unresolved."],"closing_note":"Items 8, 12 and 17 can blur whether checks occurred with how complete they were. Item 22 depends on whether its scope is the public evaluation or all verified hidden evaluations."},{"benchmark":"designqa","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The original 2024 benchmark, 1,451 pairs and public scoring software are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Engineering-document abilities, tested AI systems and intended comparisons are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Six task groups, supplied rules and images, and expected answer formats are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Instructions and settings are described, but historical inputs and settings are not fully linked to every result."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Text similarity, yes/no marking and equal weighting of six groups are described."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors connect the tasks to finding, understanding and applying engineering requirements."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Practical materials justify relevance, but one rulebook and uneven task groups limit coverage."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Additional reviewers checked manually written questions, with exceptions and more limited explanation checks."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six groups cover relevant activities, but one rulebook and limited tasks do not establish broad engineering coverage."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Correct decisions receive credit, but wording, formatting and incomplete supplied answers can affect marks."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal group weighting is documented, but evidence supporting the combined score or distinct group-skill interpretations is not supplied."},{"id":12,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Small marking tests and scoring-problem analysis show some checking, without comprehensive accuracy and consistency validation."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random guessing and other AI systems provide comparisons, but information supply differs and no engineer baseline is reported."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Five passage sets change the inputs, so they do not establish variation under identical repeated conditions."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors examine changes to passages, dimension labels, scale bars and highlighted images."},{"id":16,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Passage variation supplies limited information, but uncertainty is insufficient to judge small differences in main comparisons."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting, retrieval and component familiarity are examined, but routes to points without understanding are incompletely tested."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Image novelty and possible exposure are discussed, but systematic overlap checks and a protected set are not established."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear rules on training on questions and repeated submissions were unavailable."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No demonstrated link to other technical documents or real engineering projects is supplied."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Systems are compared, but receiving full rulebooks versus retrieved passages changes the information available."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public materials support inspection, but incomplete historical records prevent repetition of every reported result."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"A licence file and complete responsible-reuse rules were not found in the inspected material."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code history identifies revisions, but their effects on scores are not clearly documented."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The paper acknowledges important limits, while broader engineering competence and close rankings require more support."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire exposes limits in coverage, marking and comparison conditions. Several items bundle distinct requirements, so partial evidence needs an explicit explanation. The strongest interpretation is performance on these engineering tasks with the specified information supply; text-similarity scores and the combined score have weaker support as measures of engineering understanding.","supported_claims":["The benchmark examines six activities using real vehicle materials and a competition rulebook.","Testing measured sensitivity to several changes in information and visual presentation.","Results describe systems operating with their supplied rulebooks or retrieved passages."],"documented_problems":["Wording and formatting can affect credit, including missing commas and valid rules absent from supplied answers.","Task groups range from 1,192 questions to 16, while the overall score weights groups equally.","All described scale-bar drawings comply, allowing an always-yes response to earn decision credit on that portion.","One released answer file has fewer rows than the corresponding paper question count."],"missing_information":["A comprehensive study of marking accuracy and consistency.","Repeated testing with identical inputs and sufficient uncertainty estimates for close comparisons.","Complete historical records linking software, inputs and settings to results.","Clear training, submission, licensing and responsible-reuse rules.","Evidence of transfer to other documents or engineering projects."],"reinterpretations":["Read comparisons as performance of each AI together with its information supply.","Treat the overall score as an equal-weight summary of six differently marked groups.","Treat the always-yes opportunity as a scoring vulnerability, without attributing that strategy to tested systems.","Treat performance on other technical documents as uncertain."],"closing_note":"Items 12 and 17 should distinguish some checking from comprehensive validation. Item 16 leaves the required uncertainty detail dependent on the intended comparison, and item 25 can be difficult when cautious limitations accompany broader framing."}]}
